subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this WeChat hot-reload lifecycle fix include redacted live account-A/account-B QR-login proof before merge, or may the focused gateway lifecycle regressions and normal validation be accepted as sufficient?
rationale: The contributor has fixed the prior mechanical review findings but cannot access a real provider session; choosing to waive provider-level evidence changes the merge bar and requires gateway-owner judgment.

options.title: Require live WeChat evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until a real A+B QR-login handoff produces redacted logs or a recording showing account A stays online after account B is added.

options.title: Accept focused gateway proof
options.body: A gateway owner may explicitly waive live-provider proof if the reviewed lifecycle regressions are accepted as sufficient for this external-account-store handoff.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a real A+B QR-login handoff produces redacted logs or a recording showing account A stays online after account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Explicit PR-opening routing signal and the decision concerns gateway lifecycle proof standards.
